definition: water covering land that is usually dry
description: In a street of red-brick houses flooded with brown water, a laughing young woman with a long braid and a green jacket in a wooden canoe reaches up and passes a paper bag of bread to a woman leaning out of an upper-floor window. She then sits down, picks up a paddle and paddles the canoe along the street. A shaggy grey dog stands in the canoe with her. A football and a blue crate of apples float nearby, two neighbours lean out of another upper window, and sandbags lie by a door.

to reach up to the window
to look up at the bread
